name: UC4 Supply Chain Weekly Refresh + Kotaemon + Risk Alerts

nodes.name: Ingest Docs to Kotaemon
nodes.notes: Uploads synthetic supplier profiles + scraped pages to Kotaemon RAG on CT120. Requires CT120 running (provision_ct120.sh). Use --skip-scrape for faster run.

nodes.name: Query Neo4j Stats
nodes.notes: Basic auth: set Authorization header to 'Basic <base64(neo4j:PASSWORD)>'. Password from KeePass -> Neo4j.

parameters.body: {"statements": [{"statement": "MATCH (n) WHERE n.demo = true RETURN labels(n)[0] AS type, count(n) AS count ORDER BY count DESC"}]}

nodes.name: Query High Risk Suppliers
nodes.notes: Query Neo4j for suppliers with risk_score >= 0.6 to detect new HIGH/CRITICAL flags.

parameters.body: {"statements": [{"statement": "MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.risk_score >= 0.6 RETURN s.name AS name, s.country AS country, s.tier AS tier, s.risk_score AS score, s.risk_summary AS flags ORDER BY s.risk_score DESC LIMIT 10"}]}

nodes.name: Run Risk Scorer
nodes.notes: Re-scores all suppliers and writes risk_score back to Neo4j nodes.

parameters.command: cd /opt/uc4-supply-chain && NEO4J_URL=http://localhost:7474 NEO4J_PASSWORD=$NEO4J_PASS python3 src/risk_scorer.py 2>&1 | tail -20

nodes.name: Check Single-Source Risks
nodes.notes: Find all SINGLE_SOURCE relationships — these are maximum disruption risk points.

parameters.body: {"statements": [{"statement": "MATCH (p)-[r:SUPPLIED_BY|SOURCED_FROM]->(s:Supplier) WHERE 'SINGLE_SOURCE' IN r.risk_flags OR 'SINGLE_SOURCE' IN s.risk_flags RETURN p.name AS customer, s.name AS supplier, s.tier AS tier, s.country AS country ORDER BY s.tier"}]}

nodes.name: Email Risk Alert
nodes.notes: Configure SMTP in n8n credentials (Mailcow on CT207). From: noreply@research-ready.nl

parameters.subject: UC4 Supply Chain Risk Alert — {{ $('Build Alert Summary').first().json.criticalCount }} CRITICAL

nodes.name: Sync to PostgreSQL
nodes.notes: Syncs Neo4j Supplier nodes into knopenkonings.suppliers table on CT100. Requires schema created first (scripts/create_pg_schema.sh).

parameters.command: cd /opt/uc4-supply-chain && NEO4J_URL=http://localhost:7474 NEO4J_PASSWORD=$NEO4J_PASS python3 src/postgres_sync.py 2>&1 | tail -10

nodes.name: Update KPI Snapshot
nodes.notes: Write KPI snapshot to knopenkonings.kpi_snapshots via PostgreSQL REST (or via execute command). Uses HTTP POST to Neo4j to gather counts first.

parameters.body: {"statements": [{"statement": "MATCH (s:Supplier) RETURN count(s) AS total, count(s.risk_score) AS scored, avg(s.risk_score) AS avg_score, count(DISTINCT s.country) AS countries, count(s) WHERE s.tier=1 AS t1, count(s) WHERE s.tier=2 AS t2, count(s) WHERE s.tier=3 AS t3, count(s) WHERE s.tier=4 AS t4"}]}

meta.notes:
Before activating:
1. Set NEO4J_AUTH_B64 env var (base64 of 'neo4j:PASSWORD')
2. Set NEO4J_PASS env var (plain password for CLI scripts)
3. Deploy /opt/uc4-supply-chain on CT104 (or wherever n8n runs Execute Command)
4. Create knopenkonings schema: bash scripts/create_pg_schema.sh
5. Deploy Kotaemon: bash scripts/provision_ct120.sh
6. Configure SMTP credentials for Email Risk Alert node (Mailcow CT207)
7. Deploy LangGraph: cd CT119, langgraph up

Schedule: Every Monday 06:00
Duration: ~15-20 min per run (LangGraph scrape + Kotaemon ingest + risk scoring)
